system: You are a security investigator reviewing an alert. Base every claim only on the evidence available to you. Cite the record IDs that support each observation.

supporting_observations.claim: The periodic HTTPS connections attributed to the ChartMate updater went to update.chartmate-imaging.net, whereas the approved updater endpoint in the inventory is update.chartmate-imaging.com.
The process making those connections was running from ben.carter's user-writable AppData directory, rather than the inventory-listed Program Files location.

The updater process generated a file-creation event for its own executable after launch; this is compatible with an updater replacing or modifying itself, but the records do not establish what changed.
The endpoint and user attribution link the repeated outbound requests to this updater process, not just to an unidentified HTTPS client.
Some attempts to reach the .net endpoint received proxy errors, while other attempts succeeded; the errors do not change the fact that the endpoint was contacted.

The combination of an unapproved endpoint and an executable in a user-writable location is sufficiently suspicious to support a malicious-activity finding and escalation, although it does not by itself prove the updater is malware.

known_telemetry_limitations: The proxy records show CONNECT destinations and tunnel metadata, but do not show the HTTPS request or response contents; for example, the successful connection at 14:03 is represented as a tunnel (T015-00269).
The provided records do not include a file hash, signature, or reputation assessment for the AppData executable (T015-00108).
The proxy errors show failed or terminated attempts, not what the updater was trying to retrieve (T015-00152, T015-00234).
claims_not_established: Whether update.chartmate-imaging.net is controlled by ChartMate or is a malicious lookalike.
Whether the AppData executable is authentic, modified, or malicious.
Whether any update or other payload was downloaded, executed, or persisted.
Whether ben.carter knowingly installed or ran this copy of the updater.
additional_evidence_needed: Acquire the AppData cmupdate.exe and verify its hash, digital signature, provenance, and version against the vendor-approved updater.
Validate ownership and legitimacy of update.chartmate-imaging.net with the software vendor and review DNS, certificate, and proxy inspection data for the connections.
Collect endpoint file, process, and persistence history around 13:37–14:08 UTC, including any files created or processes launched by the updater.
Review endpoint protection detections and relevant proxy records for downloaded content or follow-on connections.
